_why: Picks reviewed 2026-11-18 (OpenRouter catalog + design arena + listening tests in Italian). Run `rs models` to re-check the live catalog. Override any key in ~/ReelStudio/config.json.

tts._why: Text-to-speech arena #1 (Elo 1475). Native-sounding Italian with natural pacing, follows `voice.instructions` for tone. Returns PCM; rs converts it to mp3. ~$16 / 1M chars.
tts._voices_why: Default voice per model. Gemini voices (Charon, Kore, Puck, Aoede, Fenrir, Leda, Orus, Zephyr…) speak Italian natively. MAI-Voice-2.1 has true it-IT voices (Luca, Rosa) but slow, pausy delivery. ElevenLabs premade voices are English speakers reading Italian.
tts._eleven_why: Most expressive, understands audio tags like [excited] [whispers] [pause]; English premade voices have a slight accent in Italian. --tier eleven
tts._native_why: it-IT native voices (Luca, Rosa), studio quality but slower pacing. --tier native

image._why: Small images (cards, lenses, inserts shown below ~800 px): ~$0.035/img, up to 5 reference images for style consistency.
image._hero_why: Best detail and prompt following at quality=max, ~$0.13-0.21/img, up to 16 references. ~860 px wide: use as a card, not for deep zooms.
image._world_why: 4K output (3072x5504 at 9:16, ~$0.12): big enough to be the camera's world and stay sharp up to ~2.8x zoom on a 1080 screen. Clean editorial illustration. --world
image._world_rich_why: 4K output (2304x4096, $0.04): denser, more painterly detail. --model bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5 --res 4K

stt._why: Tested 2026-11-17: the only OpenRouter STT that returned word-level timestamps (WER 3.4%, ~$0.00007/scene). voxtral-small (2.1% WER) rejects word timestamps; grok-stt / voxtral-mini returned empty bodies.

lesson._why: rs lesson: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash writes the scene plan (cheap, 1M context, JSON); Piper speaks locally.
